candidates.name: Universal Animation Library
candidates.license_provenance_warning: The official Universal Animation Library pack page still labels this pack CC0, while the publisher's general license page now presents QAL v1.0 for assets under that license. Do not infer this pack's license from the general page. At acquisition, preserve dated pack-specific CC0 evidence together with archive hashes and source URL; if the pack-specific claim changes or becomes ambiguous, stop intake for owner review.
candidates.compatibility_evidence: Official pack page states custom exports were tested in Godot and the universal humanoid rig is ready for retargeting; neither upstream nor store establishes exact Godot 4.7.1 qualification.
candidates.maintenance_evidence: Official 2026-06-16 devlog says root motion was added to all locomotion/movement animations, the Source version includes a root-motion enable/disable Blender addon, 8-direction steps were resynchronized to start with the left foot, and separate root-motion and root-motion-disabled exports are provided.
candidates.reason: The v3.0 locomotion fixes directly target foot-slide/transition risk, but exact 4.7.1/Web proof is absent and publisher licensing metadata changed after the pack release. Acquire only from the recorded official upstream/store path, preserve pack-specific license evidence and hashes, then require CIV-1 Skeleton3D/BoneMap retarget A/B, root-motion versus in-place comparison, foot-slide/grounding measurements, Web/GL cost, and real 1280x720 player-view proof before adoption.
